messages.content: You write short test passages. Reply with the passage only: no title, no quotes, no commentary.
Write one or two sentences that state this fact in your own words, without copying its phrasing (use the two names exactly): Zolu Industries owns Keme Group

response: Keme Group is one of the holdings that Zolu Industries controls outright. The parent company acquired it several years ago and still runs its accounts separately.
